issues.failure_explanation: The ordinary Lagrangian of the displayed primal problem is L=eta(1-sum_j w_j|q_j|^2)+sum_j w_j|p_j-f_jq_j|^2. Taking its infimum over eta and the freely scalable coefficients gives minus infinity: one can scale a nonzero denominator so that the coefficient of eta is negative and send eta to positive infinity. Minimizing over eta does not impose the normalization as a feasibility constraint. Thus the finite normalized quotient d(w) is not the Lagrange dual function claimed here.
